notes.title: Survival Machine just launched its EA release!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow preppers!

Survival Machine from our friends at Games Operators just launched its EA release!
If you have already dealt with the consequences of nuclear war as a prepper, now might be the right moment to survive on a giant moving machine. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601330/Survival_Machine/

What is Survival Machine?
Build your base on a moving Machine, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during the day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IO5OJXT1R6A

Those who have not heard yet we have expanded our development to two other games linked below. Feel free to check them out and feel free to follow to get new information faster! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614370/Mr_Nomad/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100690/Dust__Diesel_Deadland_Delivery/

Again, thank you very much for staying with us and being part of our community!

notes.title: Mini-games update!
notes.notes:
Hello Preppers!

We are delighted to inform you that our game has received another update! This time, we have implemented our idea from the early days of designing Mr. Prepper - the computer at home now has the ability to play mini-games. Purchase the game from Bob or Joe in the shop and beat the high scores! See the full changelog below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/c96e050d0286b73b5a3d318c21e44a56b490feda.png

Additionally, we wanted to share that our company has expanded with a new development team that will be working on a game with a similar theme to Mr. Prepper, but in a different style. We invite you to add Mr. Nomad to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614370/Mr_Nomad/

For those who are eagerly awaiting the Post-apo DLC, we have the following news: after many brainstorming sessions and approaches to production, we have decided to implement the mentioned mechanics into Mr. Prepper 2, instead of releasing a DLC for the first game. Mr. Prepper engine is already quite technologically outdated, and since it was our first game, it also has some production difficulties that would be hard to overcome in such a large DLC like the post-apo expansion. Therefore, we are now embarking on the path of designing Mr. Prepper 2, in which we plan to include everything that Mr. Prepper didn't have and probably much more. However, in order to introduce a new level of quality in the successor to our first game, we need some time for design - so for now, we are not sharing any specific dates :)


Mini-games patchnotes:


New Features:

 Added two minigames to Mr. Prepper's computer: Undead Hell and Freedom Road (buy them from traders).
 Added minigame events - beat scores to get rewards.
 Added gaming time buff while you play minigame.
 Added image explorer with concept arts to Mr. Prepper's computer.
 Added notepad with Mr. Prepper's diary to Mr. Prepper's computer.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed Tesla Coil Gun not working properly in the desert.
 Tweaks to suspicion settings of items from Farm DLC.
 You can no longer pass through walls on UFO ship (Farm DLC).
 Fixed not being able to display tooltip information on calendar event icon on crossed-out days.
 Fixed displaying multiple UFO events on the same day on the calendar (Farm DLC).
 Few tweaks to Farm DLC cut scenes.
 Other minor fixes.

notes.title: DLC Release and Combat Update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow preppers!

Today is the day! We are releasing our first DLC! On this occasion we invite you to watch the developer's stream! Also, we have released a big update with bug fixes, improvements, and combat update! Now you are able to choose from three different fighting configurations along with new weapons! Please find the full change log below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882510/Mr_Prepper__Animal_Farm_DLC/

Also, there is a bundle Main game + DLC + OST available at lower price!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25279/Mr_Prepper__Anniversary_Edition/

In addition, another update yet to come! We heard a rumor, that some of you are not satisfied with constant need of napping... We are preparing a coffee machine system as a solution, new update will be ready next month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/90b84a087ccf29c471601a60b48958a8b5237b22.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/84974180d8c743ff72a468f48026b023cb8f4939.png

Change log: 

- Added changelog to main menu 😉
- Combat overhaul.
- Two-button attack system (left and right) or select a different attack style in game settings to fit your preferences. You can also switch back to the old combat system.
- Added three new weapons: Shotgun, Halberd, and a mystery weapon from a mystery blueprint (all available in Joe's trade).
- Added new ammo type: shotgun shells.
- Improved attack animations and effects.
- Added critical hits.
- Martial Arts Book 1 unlocks the ability to walk freely while attacking, and Martial Arts Book 2 gives you a chance to make a critical hit on any enemy.
- Improved camera action during sequenced fights to eliminate excessive zooming in and out on waves of enemies.
- Added new combat tutorial
- Changed default key bind for weapon switch to F from Q. Q and E are now attack buttons by default.
- Texts with info about action keys now display actual current key binds.
- Fixed freezes on enemy spawn locations and while traveling in mines.
- Changed the room-extending button to a more eye-catching color.
- Updated the calendar with days of the week and the ability to look at future and previous months.
- Added two kitchen cupboard variants to workbench lvl 2 (previously only available in creative mode).
- Workbench box is now a regular container, and you can put anything you want in there and disassemble items from there.
- Materials will now go straight to the player's inventory instead of workbench box when disassembling items.
- When crafting gear items, it will switch automatically to the gear tab in inventory.
- When disassembling an item that has multiple color variants, you will now get recipes for all color variants at once (for example, cups or pots).
- All gems will now always appear in Bob's sell options.
- You will no longer get stuck on forest paths in specific situations.
- Added "All" tab in creative window.
- Better item quantities in creative window.
- Items will no longer expire in creative grid. 
- You can trash quest items in creative grid using the trash icon in inventory.
- Other small tweaks to creative mode.
- During pause, Prepper will no longer charge a lot of dialogues to display at once.
- Few tweaks to item suspicion settings.
- Agent buff is now dependent on grade, not on total suspicion.
- Fixed agent buff not having a proper description.
- Few crafting recipe tweaks.
- Updated credits.
- Credits button added to main menu.
- Fixed a spelling error that caused an incorrect message to display when the player tried to buy something from a vending machine with full capacity.
- Added weather to locations.
- Eat all mechanic is now available depending on the amount of food points or stamina given by the food (items that give a lot of points will not have eat all feature to prevent loss of items).
- Fixed a visual bug that occurred when the player moved equipped items directly onto the scene.
- Images on the scene will no longer cover dialogues (for example electricity icons).
- Fixed a bug that caused switches to be turned on by default but not work until the player turned them off and on again.
- Improved the display of item weight to allow for more than two digits.
- Improved the changing of dialogue colors.
- Fixed the buff system to prevent situations where buff icons were not displayed correctly.
- When Prepper goes to bed, he receives the "keep calm" buff to prevent fainting before falling asleep.
- Fixed the incorrect display of the rocket plan after completing construction.
- Fixed the functioning of trading during pause.
- Headlamp automatically turns off during NPC conversations.
- Newspaper will not fall underground anymore.
- Various minor UI tweaks.
- Other small tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow preppers!

Today, Mr. Prepper has its first anniversary! We are celebrating one year since the release. Due to this fact we have decided to add some features to the game! From now on, you are able to customize your shelter. To do so, just click on the modification box in the corner of each room and select "Customize". You will be able to select some wallpapers we have prepared (unlocked by achievements) or put your own custom textures to the "CustomRoomTextures" folder in the game directory so they will be available for selection in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/6cd89ccb2bac1adb2d25114650529222a297efcd.gif




Also we are glad to announce that the 1st DLC is on its way!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882510/Mr_Prepper__Animal_Farm_DLC/

In addition we would like to share a roadmap of how the upcoming schedule will look like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31521289/ccbc454d71e2aab971f5b25b7a6ee2df47774507.png

In the Anniversary Update we have also changed/fixed the following things:


 New customization mechanics of shelter rooms: possibility of changing textures of rooms, walls and ceilings. Unlocking new textures through achievements.
 Possibility to add custom player textures by putting an image file into the "CustomRoomTextures' folder in the game directory.

 Plants will now show an alert symbol before they wither
 Light switches in the Prepper's house are now interactive
 Fix of the misleading information "Need higher room" when planting a tree outside
 Fixed possibility of tutorial lock/stuck
 Fix of the wrongly placed tutorial arrow during the first trade
 Fix of the wrongly highlighted tree logs in the woods during the tutorial
 Fix of the issues related to item splitting
 Removed a possibility to disassemble items inside the stove
 Removed the black screen after the intro that required an action to move on
 Prepper will no longer reload a weapon each morning and after every weapon change
 Fix of the possibility of generating big trees in the woods that might cover important elements
 Fix of the looping of some enemies sounds when they were blocked on obstacles
 Fix of the bug in which the player was able to speak to Joe during his walk, which caused visual glitches
 Fix of the incorrect materials on some items (e.g. newspaper glowing in the dark)
 Items that respawn in the locations are no longer able to do so onto items left by a player (eg. logs spawning on the traps)
 Fix of the incorrect behaviour of light switches during a blackout
 Fix of the incorrect negative dialogue of the Agent when there was nothing suspicious
 Small fixes of gravity behaviour of some items in the cabin in the woods
 Fix of bugs related to the paths in the woods (blocking, next scene loading too quickly)
 Chinese text will now show with a proper speed
 Fix of the visual glitches caused by mist in some locations
 Better adjustment of the music in the intro
 Fix of the issue in which the number of items to be crafted was reset to 1 when Prepper got close to the workbench
 Other small fixes

Also please be aware that if you experience any "new" issues with the 1.16 version that you did not experience in the previous one you can always select "Legacy" branch from the "beta" settings of the app. This branch always contains the previous version to the current one.

If you would like to help us in this process and get access to the newest version before its released - please write "Chief Sitting Bull#7804" on Discord, he will introduce you to the hidden channel and grant you a special "Experimental tester" role. (Discord link:  https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr )


If you experience any crash of the game - please send us the logfile located here: AppData>LocalLow>Rejected Games>MrPrepper>output_log.txt so we can investigate your case directly. 

We read all your reports.

We will work untill the last bug is fixed.

Please use the steam community, our Discord server: https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr or email: info@rejectedgames.pl to report any issues you got with the game.

Thank you very much for your support and also please accept our apologies if something is not working as it should - we are focused on fixing right now :)

notes.title: Game Engine Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow preppers!

The engine update is now live.

It was very challenging to us to migrate the whole game from the old engine to the new one. We really hope it went well :) We performed a lot of tests and playthroughs and we experienced no issues. But it is possible that we missed something. Due to this fact the old version of the engine is still available on the "Legacy" branch. Please find instructions below how to activate the old engine if anything wrong happens to the new one.

Also - we will be fixing all the issues that might happen on the new version of the game. Please report anything to us via email: info@rejectedgames.pl or discord: https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr

1.13 Changelog:


 New game engine
 Performance should be now much better
 CPU usage highly decreased
 GPU usage highly decreased
 RAM usage decreased
 Loading times decreased
 Most of the game crashes should be now gone
 Army chests can be stacked on top of each other
 Fixed getting blocked by buckets in backyard scenes
 Small tweaks in fort observer and forest huts
 fix not being able to grab planter/room soil/greenhouse
 Fix rotten food in quick slots causing items to disappear after sleep
 Fix napping during investigation
 Fixed time problems after crushing car on way to fort observer
 Fixed items overlapping in workbench
 Tweaked investigation welcoming area
 Fixed occasional wrong shader 
 Improved waking up animation
 Fix excessive "Too heavy" message
 Fixed placement of some items on shelves
 Added missing Japanese characters
 Bob's room camera fix
 Added random dialogues for Jenny after you finish all her quests
 Joe will always sell fuel
 Fix army chests from desert becoming basic wooden chests in your inventory
 Fixed respawning items in crushed plane
 Fixed prepper going up and down ladder instead of attacking enemy
 Fixed invisible ladder climbing when going out from Bob's place 
 Agent visitation message fixed 
 Minor loading indicator issues fixed
 Korean language added

notes.title: Game Engine Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Preppers!

We noticed that some of you experiencing crashes and high CPU/GPU usage during the play. We have been collecting logs from you and realised that it might be a problem with game engine version that had it's last update on 2017 when we started the production.

Why we did not update it before?

When you start the production you start from the newest version possible. Then you proceed forward and after some time updating the engine might cause many troubles and require fixes and changes all the time. In most cases you finish the production on the version you started it with. During the tests there was no issues that told us that this step should be done. Upgrading the engine at the end of the production might postpone the release and force us to test the game many times before the release - and there were no signs that it is required at all.

But now - when we know that some of you might have troubles with crashes and high CPU/GPU usage we decided to do it. We will update the game engine to the latest possible version. It's a lot of work and a lot of testing for us but still it's worth it - you gave us amazing feedback and we know that you really like the game. In return we are starting the migration process. Hopefully the newest version of the engine will fix all the crashes and CPU/GPU usage issues and won't bring anything unexpected. 

So... nothing else to say, we are getting back to work!

Ah... If you did not leave the review yet, please do so - it is very, very important to the small devteam like ours :)


Truly yours, 
Rejected Games

notes.title: Mr. Prepper: Prologue - RELEASE STREAM
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Preppers!

We are happy to announce that the Mr. Prepper: Prologue wil be out tommorow and you can get it totally for free!

Due to this occasion we are going to do a developer stream! You will be able to watch it on the main Mr. Prepper and Mr. Prepper: Prologue steam pages and also on a PlayWay Youtube channel (27.08.2020 - 6 PM UK / 10 AM PDT / 7 PM CEST) here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-X9mro1TAmY

Visit the Prologue Steam Page by clicking here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340530/Mr_Prepper_Prologue/

What is Prologue? Mr. Prepper: Prologue is a free standalone version of the game Mr. Prepper, featuring an essential part of the story. The game contains the very beginning of the main game and allows you to get into the world of Mr. Prepper so you will be fully prepared before the final product release! :)

What is the difference between the demo and the prologue?

The demo allows you to play with the bunker and get familiar with the bunker mechanics.
The prologue contains everything what demo does, but also allows you to begin the story and other early-game mechanics of Mr. Prepper game. It's a good oportunity to prepare yourself and learn how to play before the main game comes!

So... What you're waiting for? Go and check the Prologue!

Wanna know more? Join our Discord for a more of a community experience:

https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr

Kind regards,
Rejected Games.

notes.title: Prepping for the release
notes.notes:
Greetings to all peppers!

Dust off your trench-coats and fasten your seatbelts, here's an update!

During the last few days we have had a battle to fight and some decisions to make. The content we created for Mr.Prepper has been thoroughly tested which lead us to discuss whether we are prepared to release the game. We were initially aiming to launch the game in May and were doing our utmost best to meet that vision and deadline. During our journey we have been fighting against bugs, content size and mechanics that should be implemented into the game to make it the very best we possibly can. Then it hit us and we realised that the game could be released... however, there was a possibility of making the game even better! We don't want Mr.Prepper to be a one-shot game that you will all eventually forget about. We want this game to be an adventure that is so enjoyable and immersive that you want us to expand upon it in the future. Hence we made a choice; we are not going to be releasing Mr.Prepper this month.

We are aware of the sheer amount of people waiting for Mr.Prepper's release, we are also aware that we could simply release the game, take the money and be happy that we "finished the job". However, deep down we don't want to release it right now as we have a plethora of ideas (some of which were suggested by you) and we really believe the game will be even better if we implement them first! 

Having said this, we also know that some of you will be frustrated by this news having anticipated an imminent release date. Please accept our deepest apologies. As indie developers we got a bit over excited and are not experienced with such estimations, especially with a new product we are making from scratch. We are not fully aware what we will come up with next to make the game even better, but rest assured there is a plan. But a plan is never good enough when it comes to improvements; some of them are simple and some of them are forcing us to recreate, replan, and reconstruct the game's mechanics which as a result consumes time. 

In our defence I can say that we are not asking for any money, pre-orders etc. We are just trying to make the game be the very best it possibly can and the only thing we ask for is your patience. If you give us time, we will give you a lot of joy and adventure together with Mr.Prepper. 

To assure you that we are really working on the game, we are releasing other game teaser that will show you some new things. Starting now, we will be releasing more trailers and screenshots of the game as a lot of content is ready to be shown. 

Unfortunately the release date will not be set in this update. We have failed you in that regard and we don't want to fail you again. This does not mean that the game will be released in 2022, we are just not certain about which month we will be completely satisfied with releasing the game. 

Please don't let this demotivate you though as we are going to be informing you more often about the production status and give you more media-based content updates to give you an idea of how advanced the production is for this project.

If you would like to scream at me directly please join our discord using the following invite link: https://discord.gg/BjuFWEr , I am there waiting. :)

P.S.

For those who think that postponing the game isn't fair - we strongly believe that releasing a non-completed game is not fair. We are not a big game corporation, we are just a couple of enthusiasts who are passionate about making games. Rest assured we will only release the game when we feel it is 100% complete, not just when we are forced to by upcoming deadlines. :)

Kind regards,
Rejected games.


The new teaser available here: https://youtu.be/t83KQDjPwaw

notes.title: Mr. Prepper's Release Date
notes.notes:
Greetings to all preppers around the world!

The Mr. Prepper game has become very, very popular - We are extremely grateful to the entire prepper community! Thank you guys! Due to this fact we stood before the choice; make the game “acceptable”, release it this year and then try to make it “best” in future patches or… Or make the best game but without rush. It was a hard choice. We read the threads and questions you write on the community, we read them all, we discuss them and we always try to make the game as you want it to be. During the production we have collected many requests in this matter. We asked you “What would you like to see in the game, preppers?” and you gave us a lot of cool ideas. Now it’s time to implement the best of them. The game will become bigger than we expected and hence we would like to ask your for more time. We are fully aware that you are waiting for the game, we are doing our best to make the game worth your attention but still, this process needs time. If you will give us time until May 2019 we will give you good game in return. 

In the words of the greatest Shigeru Miyamoto:

“A delayed game is eventually good, a bad game is bad forever.”

Let’s make a good game :)

And here we have some production updates:
The game will soon pass all the internal tests and we will be able to prepare the closed-beta for you. There will be official notification about it and we will ask for your opinion about our product. Also soon we will provide you with some in-game materials such as movies and screens of the new content.

Thank you once again for your patience and stay prepared!

Truly yours
Rejected Games

P.S.

If you want to scream at us now... please do, but not too much :( Don't stress the developers - they are very timid.
